description_en: Queries virtual IP addresses (VIPs) of CDN points of presence (POPs) by domain name
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-user-vips-by-domain --domain-name example.com --available on --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserVipsByDomain

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to query the virtual IP addresses of only healthy CDN POPs. Valid values:

- **on**: healthy CDN edge nodes.

- **off**: all CDN edge nodes.
parameters.description_zh:
是否查询健康VIP。取值：

- **on**：健康VIP。
- **off**：全部VIP。
